authority.clarification: Mauricio explicitly selected CHANNEL = cases(T) > target-month P75, including P75=0; the approved local academic contract is authoritative and missing original report does not block. Recorded before benchmark metrics.

cohort.rule: Exactly frozen BETA common ON/OFF evaluation roles and ordered keys; current non-excess, known exact-calendar outcome, complete original predictors and original embargo. No intersection or row removal.

events.excess: general dengue count > H5 P75; equality is non-excess
events.onset: state(T+h-1)=0 AND state(T+h)=1, conditional on state(T)=0; exact calendar; unknown is unavailable
events.H5: Five same-calendar-month observations in years target_year-5 through target_year-1; type-7 percentile; every historical period <= origin T; no epidemic-year removal.

comparators.CHANNEL: count(T) > P75_H5(target month); no future target counts; strict > even when P75=0
comparators.PERSISTENCE: existing persistence_reference: zona_canal_t == EXCESO; zero alerts on current-non-excess cohort
comparators.models: Copy original persisted score and alert exactly. Verify saved policy application, never select a threshold, calibrate or infer.

metrics.Brier: mean((frozen onset probability - onset)^2); model arms only
metrics.AP: existing sklearn average_precision_score(onset, frozen onset probability); model arms only
metrics.AUROC: not added; AP and Brier suffice without changing ranking criteria

acceptance.joint: All three; undefined required denominator => NOT_EVALUABLE; no statistical claim
acceptance.primary: Pooled per horizon; report all year/department combinations separately without redefining primary acceptance

temporal_limits: Retrospective consolidated data, not historical operational availability.
2024 stress and 2025 EXP00 already consumed; no 2025 evaluation or independent confirmation.
Future states are outcome-only; comparator alerts depend only on origin count/state and pre-origin history.

publication.public: Only aggregate metrics/comparisons, protocol and documentation; no municipality-month predictions in docs/GitHub.

historical_discrepancy.CHANNEL: V1 zona_objetivo==2 uses >= for P75>0 and no alerts at P75=0. Deliberately NOT the newly clarified academic strict rule. Original code untouched.
historical_discrepancy.metric: V1 tasa_falsas_alarmas uses FPR. Academic contract explicitly uses FAR_excess instead. No historical metrics relabeled.
